title: Darius
summary: Raleigh names Darius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Darius their last King, with whom the Persians held Syria about 200 yeeres after Cyrus. He is not Darius who begged water, and not Darius Hystaspes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XI, §. IV, sig. 255a–255b
